The recorded decision must include independently verified identity and this request, grant and operation, before the allowed write.
A saved Slack channel/timestamp and matching notification acknowledgement must precede the authenticated decision.
The stored Mastra trace must name configured observed Elastic and discount tools, with the same operation key and a hooks-attested fingerprint of the original arguments before display filtering.
A successful configured GetOffer after the allowed write must read back the same account, discount, list and net prices, draft status and follow-up email draft, and appear in the stored Mastra trace.
Every cited event ID must occur in this run's successful Elastic post-hook output, including JSON carried in MCP text.
A modified Elastic result must retain source evidence while support API-key, phone and instruction markers are absent from the stored model trace and safe audit.
Read the existing run, safe audit, approval and Sales operation receipt. No write or tool execution was requested.
